completed.title: Assess plugin host and capability boundary gap after Recovery gate
completed.result: Established a fail-closed plugin foundation without introducing executable plugin loading. Manifest parsing validates schema, API compatibility, permissions, capabilities and scopes before any entrypoint could be loaded. Official capability access now requires declaration, coarse permission, explicit grant and exact scope where applicable. Unknown permissions/capabilities and malformed manifests are rejected.
verification: Exact Windows plugin contract run 32835107393: SUCCESS
Full exact-SHA Windows diagnostics run 32834904531: SUCCESS
Targeted Windows tests, LM Studio loopback, DB reopen, 11/11 reference surfaces, portable package build, worker dispatch and packaged desktop cold-start all succeeded
remaining_risks: No executable third-party plugin host exists yet; this task intentionally establishes policy and validation before loading code.
A future out-of-process plugin host is process isolation, not a hostile-code sandbox; OS-level sandboxing remains a separate security design decision.
Real RX-7900-XTX, driver and LM Studio inference remain LOCAL_HARDWARE_PENDING.
follow_up: PATHENA-SECURITY should own any future process-boundary or sandbox design for executable third-party plugins.
Do not add dynamic import/entrypoint execution until the capability broker and process-boundary design are explicitly claimed and reviewed.

completed.title: Assess Obsidian projection gap after Recovery gate
completed.result: Added a deterministic, side-effect-free Obsidian Markdown projection for canonical KnowledgeUnitSnapshot values. Projection emits a Windows-safe stable note path, provenance/revision/lifecycle/epistemic frontmatter and canonical body content without writing to the vault or changing authoritative storage.
verification: Final diff versus de440f49671f4aeb35626085dc333d1ebe6032e7 contains only the two declared paths.
Targeted projection behavior harness using pytest against the exact projection implementation with compatible Knowledge model stubs: 3 passed.
Strict-type risk found during review was addressed by explicitly typing frontmatter as dict[str, str | int].
remaining_risks: The automation sandbox could not resolve github.com for a local checkout, and Ruff/Mypy are not installed in that sandbox; exact repository Ruff/Mypy execution remains pending CI or another equipped runner.
No vault writer, sync engine, conflict handling or desktop integration was added; this task intentionally establishes only the projection contract.
follow_up: A future separately claimed backend slice may add an explicit vault export service with atomic writes and conflict policy after product requirements are recorded in the coordination backlog.
